name: Avatard
author: rlin178
description: In the world of bending, there are four elements: earth, water, fire and air. Only the Avatar can master all four elements. With the beginning of the new generation, a new Avatar has appeared and is ready to begin their training. Learn from masters of each element and defeat them in one-on-one battles to gain mastery of all four elements. (CS3540 Spring2023 Group3 FP5)
